verdict.rationale: React's own docs include an official getting-started path: an in-browser sandbox needing no install [react-docs-20], a 'Creating a React App' guide recommending Next.js or React Router [react-docs-4, react-docs-21], and a from-scratch guide using Vite, Parcel or Rsbuild [react-docs-22]. However, the evidence shows no React-owned CLI or starter template, and actual scaffolding is handed off to third-party frameworks and build tools. Missing for 10: a first-party React CLI or scaffold template, evidence of how long setup takes, and independent hands-on corroboration of a quick setup.
